title: docs(skills): objectstack-formula says == / != on a list-valued field is refused and teaches the null-guarded membership test
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_

Fixes #36217

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：照着对外发布的公式技能写条件的 AI 作者，现在会被告知「多值字段不能直接拿来和单个值比较相等或不相等」，并拿到带空值保护的「是否包含某个值」的正确写法；此前技能对此只字未提。
- 为什么做：校验器已经开始拒绝这种比较（它在每一行上都得出同一个答案，条件永远不变），这是「多值字段相等比较收紧」那项工作欠下的技能配套，替写多选、标签类字段条件的作者解决「被拒了却不知道该怎么改」的问题。
- 出错会怎样：只改技能文字和一条发布说明，不动任何代码与契约；最坏情况是作者读到一段讲得不清楚的说明，直接撤回本次改动即可恢复原文。
- 要你做什么：审批这个受治理的技能改动（技能目录属于需要你亲自批准的范围）；席位会先完成自己的核对与达档复审再来请你。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, the published formula skill, gains a note directly under the CEL cheat-sheet's operator table. It says that `==` / `!=` between a list-valued field and a scalar is refused, names the refusal as the validator emits it, names which fields are list-valued, and shows the refused form beside the two forms that replace it:

```text
record.tags == 'vip'                             # REFUSED
record.tags != null && 'vip' in record.tags      # RIGHT, or … && record.tags.exists(t, t == 'vip')
record.tags == null || !('vip' in record.tags)   # RIGHT, replaces != 'vip'
```

The refusal the skill teaches is the one `validateExpression` emits since PR #36207 (`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`, `listEqualityRefusal`), read at `origin/main` b3bcfefcb:

- code: `list-equality`
- message, for `record.tags == 'urgent'` on a `tags` field, verbatim from a run of the validator: ``list compared with a scalar — `record.tags` holds a list (a multi-value field), and `==` compares the whole list with `"urgent"`, so the expression answers `false` on every row whatever the list holds: the condition never changes. Test membership with `in`: write `record.tags != null && "urgent" in record.tags`. To test whether the list is set, compare it with `null`.``
- for `!=` the message's answer is `true` and its rewrite is `record.tags == null || !("urgent" in record.tags)`.

The skill quotes the code and the message's opening words ("list compared with a scalar") and teaches the validator's own two rewrites.

The card's premise holds, with one correction to the forms it names. The bare forms `'x' in record.tags` and `record.tags.exists(t, t == 'x')` both validate, but both fault at evaluation when the list is `null` (measured, see Tests). The validator's own prescription is the null-guarded form, so the skill teaches that form and says why the guard is there.

### Paid for by deletion, ceiling unchanged

The file had 32 tokens of headroom under its ratchet ceiling (6008), and the note costs more. No ceiling was raised. Six restatements were cut from the same file, each keeping another home:

| Cut | Where it still lives |
|:---|:---|
| the `has()` section's opening sentence ("true whenever the key exists") | the cheat-sheet row `Key existence (NOT null-safety)`, the section heading, and the paragraph that follows |
| the Salesforce-flavor block's clause "`os build` errors with a located message, and the flow engine throws" | the `Verify your work` section |
| "Hook conditions and validation predicates bind the same two roots" | the `previous` table directly under it, and the cheat-sheet row `Previous record (update hooks, validation rules)` |
| "Record-change flow triggers ride the same dispatch" | the `previous` table's `after*` row, which names the record-change flow trigger |
| "It is a refusal, never a silent downgrade to one hook call" | the same paragraph's "the platform refuses a predicate write" |
| the translation table's double-quoted-string row | the cheat-sheet row `String literal` ("CEL parses the double-quoted form too") |

Skill size readings (lines are the measure; tokens as the ratchet counts them):

| | Before (b3bcfefcb) | After (d319685aa; `SKILL.md` unchanged since 00cef83a2) |
|:---|---:|---:|
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, lines | 491 | 493 (+2) |
| same file, priced tokens / ceiling | 5976 / 6008 | 6007 / 6008 |
| all `skills/*/SKILL.md`, lines | 4950 | 4952 (+2) |
| ratcheted authored bundle, tokens / ceiling | 197497 / 202541 | 197528 / 202541 |
| whole shipped tree, tokens | 290191 | 290222 |

`.changeset/36217-formula-skill-list-equality.md`: a `patch` for `@objectstack/skills`, which ships the `skills/**` tree through its `dist`.

One eval case is added (id 13 in `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`): a hook `condition` over a `tags` field, which must contain `record.labels != null` and `in record.labels` and must not contain `record.labels == 'urgent'`. It pins the teaching this note adds. Eval fixtures are measured by the token ratchet, not ratcheted.

## Tests

Nothing here changes tested behaviour, so there is no ablation. The forms the skill teaches were measured against the validator and the evaluator at b3bcfefcb, with a throwaway probe over a `tags` field and a `user` field declared `multiple: true`:

<details><summary>Probe readings</summary>

| Expression | `validateExpression` | evaluated on a list holding the value / not holding it / `null` |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `record.tags == 'urgent'` | refused, `list-equality` | `false` / `false` / `false` |
| `record.tags != 'urgent'` | refused, `list-equality` | `true` / `true` / `true` |
| `record.owners == 'u1'` (`multiple: true`) | refused, `list-equality` | `false` / `false` / `false` |
| `'urgent' in record.tags` | accepted | `true` / `false` / faults: "no such overload: string in dyn(null)" |
| `record.tags != null && 'urgent' in record.tags` | accepted | `true` / `false` / `false` |
| `record.tags == null \|\| !('urgent' in record.tags)` | accepted | `false` / `true` / `true` |
| `record.tags.exists(t, t == 'urgent')` | accepted | `true` / `false` / faults: "Expression of type 'null' cannot be range of a comprehension" |
| `record.tags != null && record.tags.exists(t, t == 'urgent')` | accepted | `true` / `false` / `false` |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The cuts fall outside the operator-table area the claim's file surface describes, inside the same file. They are the payment the ratchet asks for; each row above names the surviving home.
- After this change the file's headroom is 1 token.
- The card's two bare membership forms are accepted by the validator and fault on a `null` list. The validator's refusal already prescribes the guarded form, so this is noted here and not filed.

## Verification

Read first: the new note under the cheat-sheet table in `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, then the six deletions in the same diff.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — expect the formula row to read `6007 / 6008` and every file within its ceiling.

<details><summary>Local gates at d319685aa</summary>

The derived set (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 49 commands, the same set with the eval file in the change set) was run in full at 00cef83a2 and again at d319685aa; `--ran` reconciliation: "49 derived, 47 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". 47 exited 0, among them `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`, `pnpm check:skill-links`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:published-files`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`.

NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` (exit 3, prerequisite not met: they read every package's built output, and only the formula and lint closures were built here). Both are whole-tree families this diff does not feed; CI runs them.

Outside the derived set: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs` exit 0; `check:skill-examples` NOT MEASURED (exit 3, needs the client packages built).

</details>
